# Wharf 0.10.0 changes

- Added the `Wharf.Verifier` pristine verification boundary.
- Added source-to-fresh-workspace copying and injectable patch application.
- Added sequential verifier commands with per-command timeout and explicit
  credential environment names.
- Added raw command logs, applied patch evidence, and atomic versioned trial
  results.
- Added fake-agent/verifier tests proving workspace separation and hidden
  material boundaries.
- Deliberately did not merge or tag; manual testing is required before
  release.
